summary.text: On Rath, after Volrath abandons his post as Evincar, would-be successors fight a brutal contest in the Stronghold, which Crovax, chosen by Phyrexia and given new powers, comes to dominate while Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.

Belbe, a Phyrexian emissary built from the murdered Avila, oversees the contest but grows disillusioned, falls in love with Ertai and sabotages flowstone production, while Rath's rebels unite in Eladamri's name against Phyrexia's tyranny.

The uprising fails, but Belbe helps Eladamri and the last survivors escape to Dominaria, Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar and executes Volrath, and the flowstone machinery resumes full operation as the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.
